invariants.rule: Keep accountable roles separate from named Agent Profiles.
Keep logical Team Presets separate from host concurrency.
Do not let personalization change authority, rules, gates, evidence, or independence.
Keep project-specific rules at their authoritative project source.
Maintain a Work Context for every request and persist a Task only when durable coordination or governance adds value.
Do not label self-review, peer challenge, or co-authored work as independent review.
Support completion claims with applicable evidence and gate state.
Inject the smallest sufficient runtime projection and recompose it when governing inputs change.
